changes: The public fisher ledger: A says 'AI must produce a fisher-transition ledger. B says 'Keep the ledger transparent in totals and by community, but let an independent auditor hold the names.'

The export refusal: A says 'AI must refuse to process Mexican seafood export documentation from the Upper Gulf region that does not certify gillnet-free catch.' B says 'Build the certification and the gear support first. Then set a date for the refusal.'

The actor: A says 'AI must' perform several actions; B says 'When you say AI must do these things, readers will picture a chatbot and stop listening. AI does not hold money or sign customs agreements. Name the actors instead.'
